* The founder of now-defunct crypto exchange *FTX* is currently serving a 25-year sentence after a jury convicted him on seven counts of fraud, conspiracy, and money laundering for misappropriating customer funds and defrauding investors and lenders.

* Bankman-Fried also claimed that the order to forfeit $11 billion violates the 8th Amendment's bar on excessive fines.

Claude was asked to help build bioweapons Anthropic released a new threat intelligence report describing attempts to use its models for biological and conventional weapons research. The cases are specific.  Researchers asked Claude for help with gain-of-function work involving chikungunya and with assessing the pandemic potential of avian influenza.  In one instance the researchers were working at a military research institute outside the United States.  Anthropic says its safeguards blocked some of the requests and triggered internal investigations. The report also covers six cases tied to conventional weapons development, with activity linked to China, Russia and Yemen. Anthropic banned the accounts involved, disrupted the networks being used to get around regional restrictions and shared what it found with governments and other AI companies.
